_comment_: Merge this into ~/.claude/settings.json. If that file already exists with other settings, merge the 'hooks' key (and its sub-keys) into the existing JSON rather than replacing the file. The 'matcher' uses Claude Code's PostToolUse event for any Write or Edit tool call; the command is the vault hook script that rebuilds the graph index and auto-links the changed note. The script itself does its own filtering — it bails out cleanly if the edited file isn't a markdown file inside the vault, so wiring it user-globally is safe.
